name: m2-h264-aac.mp4
purpose: M2 MP4/H.264 input with an AAC track that must be explicitly omitted
command: ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=640x360:rate=30:duration=2 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=880:sample_rate=48000:duration=2 -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 30 -keyint_min 30 -sc_threshold 0 -c:a aac -b:a 96k -movflags +faststart -metadata "title=Diaxus M2 deterministic fixture" fixtures/m2-h264-aac.mp4
